body:
Adds `research/stopping-scores`: a verifier that checks a claim sequentially and stops when it likes, paid a proper score. The optimal policy is a symmetric threshold (matches dynamic programming over all policies), with closed forms for delivered accuracy, expected checks, participation scale, and the sequential vs fixed-sample gain. Includes a white paper, 8 tests, experiments, README and portfolio page entries.
